code:
CREATE PROCEDURE
  dbo.usp_CustomerOrderHistory
  @CustomerID INT AS BEGIN
  SELECT OrderID, OrderDate, OrderStatus,
    OrderTotal, ShipDate
  FROM dbo.Orders WHERE CustomerID =
    @CustomerID AND OrderDate >= -12mo
END
caption: dbo.Orders: ~14 million rows. Nothing exotic about this query.
